caption_used: 图表展示了不同超参数设置对BLEU分数的影响，包含两个子图。左图中横轴为知识蒸馏权重α，范围从0.1到0.9；右图中横轴为掩码概率p，范围从0.05到0.45。两图纵轴均为BLEU得分，范围从28.0到28.6。左图显示α=0.5时BLEU达到峰值约28.53，α=0.1时最低约27.95。右图中p=0.15时BLEU达到峰值约28.53。值得注意的是，参数p对BLEU分数的影响幅度明显大于α，p在0.25处出现显著下降至约28.1后又回升，表明模型对掩码概率的选择更为敏感；相较之下α的影响曲线则较为平缓对称。
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure presents two line charts illustrating the impact of different hyperparameter settings on BLEU scores, with the left chart showing the effect of knowledge distillation weight α and the right chart showing the effect of mask probability p. Both charts share a common y-axis labeled "BLEU" with a range from 28.0 to 28.6, marked at intervals of 0.1. The x-axis of the left chart is labeled α, ranging from 0.1 to 0.9 with numerical tick marks at 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, and 0.9, and the data points are connected by a solid blue line with circular markers. The BLEU score starts at approximately 27.95 at α = 0.1, increases to a peak of about 28.53 at α = 0.5, and then decreases to around 28.1 at α = 0.9. The x-axis of the right chart is labeled p, ranging from 0.05 to 0.45 with tick marks at 0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.35, and 0.45, and the data points are also connected by a solid blue line with circular markers. The BLEU score begins at approximately 28.3 at p = 0.05, rises to a peak of about 28.53 at p = 0.15, decreases to around 28.1 at p = 0.25, and then increases slightly to about 28.4 at p = 0.45.
